messages:
marta: heads-up: saw a customer report where provisional tokens show up, then disappear after a stream fallback + truncation. billing UI shows a blip, then final charge is much lower.

sam: any logs or trace ids?

marta: trace: `r-77a3f1` — runtime emitted a provisional charge as soon as chunk started, then client reconnected and routed to a cheaper variant which truncated output. finalization event never reconciled visibly in console.

liam: is this the old provisional window behavior? we always emit provisional immediately so quota checks don't block the client.

marta: yeah. it's the same flow but edge-case when fallback route returns early truncation. we end up double-reporting in provisional ledger until reconciliation prunes it. customers see the provisional blip in the live billing panel and file tickets.

nick: can we avoid emitting provisional until ack window passed? that delays quota enforcement for long requests though. risk: DOS if we don't reserve.

jen: idea: keep provisional but mark it as "pending" in the console and telemetry. show final when a `finalize` event arrives. add hover text explaining provisional semantics.

sam: agree on UI change. but backend needs stronger guarantees: either a guaranteed finalize or a noop that's idempotent. current finalize is best-effort.

liam: technical proposal: attach `session_ack_id` to every stream and include it in provisional ledger entries. when fallback occurs, runtime emits `finalize(session_ack_id, finalized_tokens, reason)`. ledger reconciles by ack_id. if finalize never arrives within grace window, mark as stale and present as "stale provisional" in UI.

marta: that helps debugging. we should also emit a telemetry counter `billing.provisional_finalized` and a histogram `billing.provisional_finalization_latency_ms`.

nick: what's the grace window? current 5s might be too short for some multi-hop handoffs. If we extend to 20s we increase memory on the ledger.

jen: put grace window behind a rollout flag per-customer. default 10s. canary larger windows for enterprise with higher SLA.

sam: also need to handle toolcalls: if toolcall triggers during streaming and is retried, we get provisional tokens for tool + stream. we need to attribute finalization into `primary_session` vs `tool_session`.

marta: yep. propose ledger entry shape: `[{type: "provisional", ack_id: "...", session: "primary|tool:<id>", route: "gpu-a", tokens: 123, ts: ...}]` and finalize sets `final_tokens` and `route.finalized`.

liam: quick example API response we'd like from runtime:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Session-Ack: r-77a3f1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "provisional_tokens": 120,
  "provisional_id": "p-abc123",
  "note": "pending finalization",
}
```
and later: `POST /internal/billing/finalize {"provisional_id": "p-abc123", "final_tokens": 8, "reason": "truncated_by_fallback"}`

nick: small ask: make finalize idempotent and include `finalized_at` + `observed_route`. we'll need that in console to show why charge changed.

jen: UX: billing panel should show two columns: Pending / Finalized with links to traces and `observed_route`. Hover explains provisional = counted for quota but may be reconciled. Add a filter to hide pending for support view.

sam: telemetry-wise, add `billing.finalized_ratio` per-route and per-customer. trigger alert if ratio drops below 80% (means lots of provisional churn).

marta: support tickets we saw were from customers hitting quotas because provisional counted toward soft-limit but then final was lower -> false positives. need to separate "soft reserve" (affects throttling) vs "billed" (finalized).

liam: good point: quota enforcement should use `reserved_tokens` separate from `provisional_tokens`. reserved_tokens = tokens the system may temporarily hold for short window, but not guaranteed billed. makes enforcement decoupled.

nick: implementation plan: 1) add `session_ack_id` to stream handshake (runtime change), 2) emit provisional ledger entries with ack_id and route, 3) finalize endpoint with idempotency, 4) telemetry metrics + UI flags, 5) rollout via feature flag per-org.

jen: can we ship UI only first? hide provisional from public billing but expose in support view, while runtime/ledger changes land. reduces noise for customers while we iterate.

sam: deploy plan: feature flag `billing.pending_ui` default off. rollout to internal + 3 canary orgs. runtime: feature flag `billing.ack_v2` default on for canaries. gather `billing.provisional_finalized` for 48h before switching UI on.

marta: action items: @sam add PR for ledger finalize endpoint + schema. @liam update runtime handshake to attach ack_id. @nick update billing UI mockups and support filter. @jen create support docs explaining provisional behavior. I'll own telemetry dashboard for `finalized_ratio`.

sam: noted. I'll start PR and add API contract in eng-platform repo.

liam: I'll prototype ack_id in runtime this afternoon, will ping with small trace sample.

nick: mockups ETA EOD tomorrow.

jen: docs draft by Friday.

marta: thanks team. let's try to avoid another round of "why I was double charged" tickets. :crossed_fingers:

billing-bot: auto-note: new metric `billing.provisional_finalization_latency_ms` created in staging.
